primary_rule: Maximize min((F1-shared_GRPO_F1)/.05,(1-generated/shared_GRPO_generated)/.30); tie by F1-.03*cost, then reverse lexicographic name.
secondary_rule: Best remaining candidate of a distinct architecture kind from primary.
note: Predeclared before either validation64 result. Selection is not target success; retain all validation attempts and raw paired test outcomes. No candidate/threshold tuning on final test.
